title: Duration Dividend Schedule: Long Continuous Coverage Under the Whole Life Insurance Accumulate Option
content:
**Applies to:** dividends placed on deposit on Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policies, including policies issued by conversion of an Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy.

## Schedule

The dividend placed on deposit is raised for long continuous coverage on the insured, counted in whole months **to the anniversary** from the issue date of the Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy converted into this policy, or from this policy's own issue date when it was not issued by conversion:

| Whole months of continuous coverage to the anniversary | Never reinstated | Raised by |
|---|---|---|
| 360 or more | Yes | 3% (0.03) |
| 240 or more, below 360 | Yes | 1.5% (0.015) |
| Below 240 | Yes | Not raised |
| Any | No | Not raised |

The percentage is a share of the dividend being placed on deposit; percentage changes to the amount placed on deposit are added together and applied once to the dividend, never one on top of another, with one rounding half up to the cent at the end.

## Records read

- Whole life policy record: issue date, converted term policy reference, reinstatement date (empty if never reinstated), and the anniversary the posted values are as of.
- Term Life Insurance policy record of the converted term policy: its issue date.

A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the start date is reached.

## Cases (hypothetical, anniversary June 1, 2025)

- Converted from a Term Life Insurance policy issued June 1, 1995; never reinstated: 360 months, raised by 3%.
- Converted from a Term Life Insurance policy issued June 2, 1995: 359 months, raised by 1.5%.
- Issued on application June 1, 2010: 180 months, not raised.
- Converted from a term policy issued in 1990 but reinstated in 2018: not raised.
